correctness.rationale: The exact combinatorial identity is pathwise, and the predictor compensator is exact. Bounded-step hypergeometric martingale FCLT yields the centered Brownian-bridge SDE and driving noise jointly. The compensator endpoint uses hypergeometric variance O(1-u), and martingale endpoint uses quadratic variation O(eta). The discontinuity in maximizing indices is handled by smoothing plus vanishing Gaussian near-tie occupation and Itô isometry. Triple ties are polar for the limiting diffusion away from bridge endpoints; rank Tanaka with symmetric local time yields the factor 1/2 and pathwise terminal identity. The known two-type Rayleigh law checks normalization. Exhaustive 4362 finite deck enumeration verifies non-asymptotic identities but does not prove the limit.
